d:
Singer Diljit Dosanjh’s Ahmedabad concert has become embroiled in a new controversy. Videos from the show, held on November 21 at the Narendra Modi Stadium, are circulating on social media. These clips show a physical altercation between some young men during the concert, as well as an individual allegedly using an e-cigarette. These incidents have raised questions regarding the security arrangements at the event and the screening process for prohibited items.
